title: Trump’s Obsession With Immigration Is Really an Obsession With Segregation. His policies...
content: Trump’s Obsession With Immigration Is Really an Obsession With Segregation. His policies are a continuation of the 1790 Naturalization Act (only landowning white men were citizens), the 1882 Chinese Exclusion Act, the 1924 Johnson-Reed Act, etc.
author: Jason Kottke
